wars.note: 'he declared war on the Vajjika League in 484 BCE' and the league 'required him having recourse to diplomacy and intrigues over the span of a decade'; the Ajatashatru page (read for Basham's 485 and 481-480 campaigns, Vassakara and the Buddha's reasons for the Vajjis' strength) agrees on 484-468. The contest on the map starts with the second campaign, -481.

certainty.note: The league's rivers and the Himalaya bound it only loosely; the Malla republics inside it kept sovereign rights and the Licchavi-Videha frontier is not given.

notes: Two pages for two shapes. Not settled: (1) The Cliopatria shape is a 5,164 km2 disc; the corrected polygon is my reading of the page's four boundaries and covers north Bihar and the Nepal Terai (about 60,000 km2): no page gives an area, and the Mallas, who were inside the league, are kept in janapada-of-malla. (2) The Cliopatria 'Mahajanapadas' row (-480..-451) repeats this disc; it should be treated as Vajji for -480..-468 and dropped afterwards (the land is Magadha's from 468). (3) The page's dates are the Mahavamsa-style short list of the Haryanka page (war from 484); under the short chronology everything is about 90 years later. (4) The pre-600 life: Videha (Maha-Videha 'Around 800 BCE') is the predecessor; no dossier exists in this group. (5) Gazetteer names wanted: Vaishali (place), Videha / Mithila (region), Terai (region), Mahananda (river). The page does not mention the sixteen Mahajanapadas list although Cliopatria and the Mahajanapadas umbrella treat Vajji as one.
